resources.string: Short brain games for a quick break, about a minute each. Offline, no ads, no subscription.
Echo: is the shape the same as the one before? Tap Yes or No, or swipe right for yes and left for no. The first card is just to remember. From level 10 you compare with the card two back.

Switches: lights roll out of the portal one after another. Tap a junction to flip it, so every light reaches the gate with its colour and shape. A round lasts 90 seconds, and the better you route, the closer the lights follow each other. 90% or more on target moves you up a level, below 70% down. Higher levels have more gates.

Constellation: a few stars light up in the night sky and go dark again. Tap where they were. Two wrong taps end the pass. A perfect pass draws the constellation and adds a star, one mistake keeps the count, two take one away.

Ink: does the meaning of the word on the left match the ink colour of the word on the right? Only the colour on the right counts, not what it says. Ink lives on colour and is only partly playable with strong colour blindness. Colour-blind mode keeps it to four colours that stay apart with red-green weakness.
Every day thinkr picks up to three games for you. A game counts as soon as you have played a round of it today. One missed day per week does not break your streak.
Relaxed gives you half again as much time, with slower cards and lights, and keeps its own levels and best scores.
The games run against the clock and are hardly playable with a screen reader.
For fun. Not a medical device, no health claims.
